meta.name: type:invoice_foreign

changelog.note: Party_orientation on supplier_tax_id/buyer_tax_id, a to-do at buyer_tax_id when the pair stands the other way round than on most earlier documents of this type (worker runs only; jav/party_history.py). Extraction requests are unchanged.

Silent content errors: distinct_parties role-pair check(s) supplier_tax_id/buyer_tax_id, supplier_name/buyer_name; a to-do at the second field when both name one party (jav/fact_checks.py). Extraction requests are unchanged.

Decision of 2026-09-29: a tax number check for both parties (tax_id, optional): a recognised form (jav/taxid.py), otherwise a to-do; the foreign invoice had no tax number check until now. The extraction unchanged

Parent and the legacy detect.json's keywords for choosing the detailed type (source: 10_AIFLOW_V4/flows/doc-extract-bare/types/invoice_foreign/detect.json, sha256 dbb231004da3e1e5); the extraction unchanged

Type pack (a legacy type carried over): the foreign invoice from the legacy project - its field list in the legacy schema.json's order (16 fields, supplier_country a new kind: country), required fields and validators verbatim from the legacy rules.json (required: invoice_number, gross_total; named: date_order, iban_check optional; fields: currency ^[A-Z]{3}$, supplier_country ^[A-Z]{2}$), scoring by the legacy _compare_contract (payment_iban and the addresses not scored); the high-stakes fields: the policy's base set narrowed to the fields of the schema (amount_due is not in it); the prompt and the schema verbatim; S path call site select_foreign, G path verify_foreign; candidate profile intl

date_order optional: a missing due date is no error (one case of the legacy golden set, an Upwork receipt, has no due_date; the legacy rules.json asks only for the format); after the first S path golden run
